Class TradingEngine

java.lang.Object
com.exchange.engine.TradingEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
TradingService
public class TradingEngine extends Object implements TradingService
Core transactional trading engine handling order matching, balance debits/credits, portfolio mutation, and execution reporting with strong validation guarantees.
